items.title: Unit 6 · Let's play after school!
items.scene: My name's Max. After school, I do my homework. Then I go to the park. I play football with my friends. Then I watch TV. I'm Julia. I love art. After school, I draw and paint pictures. Then I write stories. I put the stories and pictures on my bedroom wall. I'm Luke. After school, I help my mum and dad. Then I listen to my CDs. I sing the songs. I really like music. My name's Sara. I like sport. I go swimming every Monday. I play tennis with my brother every Tuesday. And every Thursday I skate in the park with my sister.
